title: 第1785章 初到蚩生魂界第1784章 叶非凡的任务
content_zh:
“原来是前来协助的叶道友，感谢叶道友前来支援我离魂岛。
想来叶道友初到我离魂岛，必然对于现在的一些情况不太了解，我这就找人带你熟悉下。”
吕无边闻言立即客套了一句，随后对着身后的一名女修说道。
“杨道友，麻烦你带着叶道友去战魂阁一趟。”
“好，叶道友，请随我来吧。”
杨真立即上前一步对着叶非凡拱了拱手。
“那就麻烦杨道友了。”
叶非凡立即点头答应，听从对方的安排。
“吕道友，告辞。”
离开破界树所在的大殿后，外界的景色相当正常，与其他界域并无明显不同之处。
并且叶非凡没有听到四周有海浪的声音，也没有任何湿润的感受，明显不像是在海岛上的样子。
这不就是陆地中的某处么......
为什么要叫离魂岛？？？直接叫离魂宗不就行了。
按理说宗门取名字应该不会特别随意才是，或多或少还是要有点关联。
难道有像逍遥老祖那样的人？？
可炎阳至尊看着就很正经，他能够同意？
叶非凡一边看着离魂岛的景色一边默默吐槽。
没过多久，杨真便带着叶非凡来到一处三层楼高的阁楼里。
别看阁楼不高，但占地面积却是颇广，因此显得矮胖矮胖的。
“叶道友，这里便是战魂阁了。

这次炎阳至尊安排过来支援离魂岛的修士均需要先来这里找甘副岛主了解下情况，并且后续你们在离魂岛上如何居住和行动也需要听从甘副岛主的安排。”
杨真简单给叶非凡说明下，免得他一头雾水。
“嗯，多谢杨道友。”
“杨真，你旁边这位就是过来支援的道友么？
但只有他一人？”
此时甘辉从战魂阁一层的后方中走了出来。
甘辉修为在大乘中期，作为离魂岛的副岛主以及燃金使徒，的确有资格接待和安排其他界域来的修士。
不过他还是有点奇怪为什么只有叶非凡一人。
要知道炎阳至尊要求其他界域安排人过来支援那都是结伴而行，根本不会有修士脱离团队独自行动。
像之前甘辉已经接待了二十来人，他们或多或少都是几人一同过来。
“弟子杨真，拜见甘副岛主。
回甘副岛主，这位是来自八方山岚界的叶非凡叶道友。”
“晚辈叶非凡，拜见甘前辈。”
叶非凡连忙对着甘辉拱手行礼。
他本不是离魂岛的修士，因此直接称呼前辈即可。
对方大乘期的修为他能够模糊的感应到。
“哈哈哈，原来是叶非凡叶道友，那我就明白了。
好了，杨真，你回去吧，叶道友交给我就行。”
甘辉听到叶非凡名字一脸恍然，随后便继续按照正常流程来。
“是，甘副岛主，弟子告退。”

待到战魂阁内只剩甘辉和叶非凡时，甘辉对着叶非凡微微拱了拱手，给足了面子。
“甘辉，燃金使徒，同时也是离魂岛的副岛主，见过叶道友。
叶道友双十杰的成就就算是我也有所耳闻，当真是厉害。”
“多谢甘前辈夸赞。”
“呵呵，叶道友请坐，我们先简单聊一下。
content_en:
"It turned out to be Fellow Daoist Ye who came to assist. Thank you for coming to support me on Lihun Island.
I think that since you, Daoist Ye, have just arrived at my Soul-Living Island, you must not know much about some of the current situation. I will find someone to help you get familiar with it. "
Lu Wubian immediately said politely after hearing this, and then said to a female cultivator behind him.
"Fellow Daoist Yang, please take Friend Daoist Ye to War Soul Pavilion."
"Okay, Fellow Daoist Ye, please come with me."
Yang Zhen immediately stepped forward and cupped his hands towards Ye Feifan.
"Then I'll trouble you, Fellow Daoist Yang."
Ye Feifan immediately nodded in agreement and obeyed the other party's arrangements.
"Fellow Daoist Lu, take your leave."
After leaving the main hall where the Boundary Breaking Tree is located, the scenery outside is quite normal and is not significantly different from other realms.
Moreover, Ye Feifan did not hear the sound of waves around him, nor did he feel any moisture. It was obviously not like he was on an island.
Isn't this somewhere in the land...
Why is it called Lihun Island? ? ? Just call Lihun Sect.
It stands to reason that the name chosen by the sect should not be particularly random, but should be more or less related.
Are there people like Ancestor Xiaoyao? ?
But Supreme Yanyang looks very serious, can he agree?
Ye Feifan complained silently while looking at the scenery of Lihun Island.
Not long after, Yang Zhen took Ye Feifan to a three-story attic.
Although the attic is not high, it covers a large area, so it looks short and squat.
"Fellow Daoist Ye, this is the War Soul Pavilion.
This time, the monks arranged by Yanyang Supreme to support Lihun Island need to come here first to find out the situation from Deputy Island Master Gan. In addition, how you live and act on Lihun Island will also need to follow Deputy Island Master Gan's arrangements. "
Yang Zhen gave Ye Feifan a brief explanation so that he would not be confused.
"Well, thank you, Fellow Daoist Yang."
"Yang Zhen, is this fellow Taoist next to you the one who came to support you?
But just him? "
At this time, Gan Hui walked out from the back of the first floor of the War Soul Pavilion.
Gan Hui's cultivation is in the middle stage of Mahayana. As the deputy island owner and Burning Gold Apostle of Lihun Island, he is indeed qualified to receive and arrange for monks from other realms.
But he was still a little surprised why Ye Feifan was the only one.
You must know that when Yanyang Supreme asks people from other realms to come over to support him, he will do so in groups. There will be no monks who will leave the team and act alone.
Gan Hui had already received about twenty people before, and more or less they all came together.
"Disciple Yang Zhen, pay homage to Vice Island Master Gan.
The deputy island owner of Hui Gan, this is Fellow Daoist Ye Feifan from the Lan Realm of Bafang Mountain. "
"Junior Ye Feifan, I would like to pay my respects to Senior Gan."
Ye Feifan quickly bowed his hands to Gan Hui.
He is not a monk from Lihun Island, so he can just call him senior.
He could vaguely sense the opponent's Mahayana cultivation level.
"Hahaha, it turns out to be Ye Feifan, fellow Taoist Ye, then I understand.
Okay, Yang Zhen, you can go back. Just leave Daoyou Ye to me. "
Gan Hui was stunned when he heard Ye Feifan's name, and then continued to follow the normal procedure.
"Yes, Vice Island Master Gan, this disciple is resigning."
When only Gan Hui and Ye Fan were left in the War Soul Pavilion, Gan Hui slightly arched his hand towards Ye Fan to show his face.
"Gan Hui, the Burning Gold Apostle and the deputy island owner of Lihun Island, has met Daoyou Ye.
Even I have heard about Ye Daoyou's achievements as one of the top ten heroes, and they are really amazing. "
"Thank you, Senior Gan, for the compliment."
"Haha, Fellow Daoist Ye, please sit down, let's have a brief chat first.
